traits.habitat_notes: A cosmopolitan weed of fields, gardens, pavement cracks and waste places in warm and temperate regions, 0-2800 m; introduced in North America (perhaps pre-Columbian).
traits.habit_notes: A low, succulent mat: many fleshy, glabrous, reddish stems radiate from a short taproot and lie flat on the ground, branching freely, their tips rising a little. Leaves thick and fleshy, spoon-shaped, crowded toward the stem ends and under the flower clusters. A few inconspicuous stiff bristles in the leaf axils. Flowers open singly for a few hours on sunny mornings. Capsule opens by a lid (circumscissile), showing many glossy black seeds 0.6-1.1 mm.
